kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نكتحل (form VIII)
# نَكْتَحِلُ (naktaḥilu) /nak.ta.ħi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# نَكْتَحِلَ (naktaḥila) /nak.ta.ħi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# نَكْتَحِلْ (naktaḥil) /nak.ta.ħil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
